info.name: Runbook
info.summary: Create, execute and track repeatable procedures as structured, collaborative runbooks.
info.description:
# Runbook
**Runbook** is a Nextcloud application for creating, executing and tracking repeatable procedures.
It transforms static checklists and procedural documents into structured, collaborative workflows that teams can execute consistently and trace from start to finish.
Teams can create reusable runbook templates for operational procedures such as server deployments, employee onboarding, maintenance routines, security reviews, production releases, audits, month-end processes and any other repeatable activity.
Each runbook execution creates an independent historical snapshot of the procedure. Steps can be assigned to users, completed individually, supplied with structured responses, comments and supporting evidence, while Runbook maintains a complete activity history of the execution.
Runbook integrates naturally with Nextcloud users and groups for access control, assignments and collaboration while keeping its own data model and business logic isolated from the rest of the platform.
Its purpose is simple:
**Turn procedures into repeatable, accountable and traceable execution.**
### Core capabilities
Runbook allows teams to:
- Create reusable procedure templates with sections and ordered steps. - Start independent runs from published templates. - Assign runs and individual steps to Nextcloud users. - Share templates and runs with Nextcloud users and groups. - Collect confirmations, text, numbers, dates, selections and files during execution. - Add comments and operational evidence. - Track progress, deadlines and overdue work. - Maintain a complete execution history. - Search templates and runs through Nextcloud. - Surface assigned work from the Nextcloud Dashboard. - Configure application policies from Nextcloud Administration Settings. - Use the application in multiple languages through the standard Nextcloud translation system.
Runbook does not modify Nextcloud users, groups or global permissions. Nextcloud identities are only referenced for authentication, assignment and access control.
Runbook is designed to be useful for IT, operations, HR, finance, quality, security, customer service, facilities and any other team that relies on repeatable procedures.
